Depict only the named feature with an original composition. Finished full-bleed polished wide cover, not a collage or multiple separate covers.

The MCM plaque is required for every cover in this collection. Do not substitute a gear, compass, pictogram or blank ornament for the MCM letters. Keep only the exact mod title and MCM as lettering.
